notes.title: Will_less playertest update log 2024.3.1
notes.content:
Thank you for the feedback from the testing users. In response to their feedback and information, we have made the following adjustments to the testing version package

1. Adjust the corresponding logic of the character's sprint attack, which can quickly affect the effect of the sprint attack after adjustment

2. Adjusting the effect of attribute BUFF to simplify tedious attribute selection

3. The issue of delayed release after adjusting Andy's arm armor and blade type weapon skills

4. Adjust some BUFF acquisition plans so that stores in the level can obtain new attribute items

5. Fix some known bugs

6. Optimize the artistic effects of some characters
